title: Kuro made with your original 3D workflow (ChatGPT chibi, then Meshy)
question: The first sheets are pictures (the chibi picture steps), the rest are renders of a real rigged 3D model; open the live 3D link to turn her and watch her idle and walk beside the in-game Eric and Mio. Does Kuro fit next to them, and should the other characters go through the same steps?

media.caption: Pictures, step 1, ask 1 as you wrote it: "make a 3d chibi anime character of the woman in image 1, in the style of the attached image 2. Full body, plain white background." Image 1 her approved portrait (game3d/assets/portraits/kuro-neutral.webp), image 2 your Mio chibi picture (tools/characters/ref/mio-chibi-34.png). No ChatGPT here, so each ask is one FLUX.2 Klein 4B edit on the local GPU (4 steps, CFG 1, 896x1184), fed the picture the ask before made. Seeds 101 to 104: all four came out as Mio again (her buns, hoodie and cargo trousers).
Ask 1 again with one sentence added: "Her hair, face and clothes come from image 1; only the 3D style comes from image 2." Seeds 111 to 114: still Mio.

Ask 1 with her look in words instead: "black hair in one high bun on the back of her head, a straight blunt fringe and long side locks, half-lidded grey eyes, dark lips, a dark teal blazer over a black shirt, a dark knee-length pencil skirt and black flat shoes." Seeds 121 to 124: now Kuro, but smooth vinyl, not Mio's faceted look. The skirt and flats are my choice; her portrait stops at the waist. Glasses left out, as the workflow says. a-123 and a-122 went on.

Ask 2 as you wrote it: "simplify the character in image 1 a LOT to match the detail level of the other chibi in image 2, with open eyes." b-201 to b-203 from a-123, b-211 to b-213 from a-122. They went flat 2D, and b-201, b-202 and b-211 took Mio's buns back.

Ask 2 again from a-123 with one sentence added: "Keep her a 3D render with flat faceted low-poly surfaces, like image 2." Seeds 221 to 224. b-221 has Mio's cargo pocket marks on the skirt. b-222 went on.

Ask 3, removing what Meshy garbles: "Remove the buttons and the pocket flaps from her blazer, and make the two long locks of hair beside her face thicker. Keep everything else exactly the same." Seeds 301 to 304 from b-222. The thicker locks became long hair, which changes her, so I dropped that half.
Ask 3 again with one change: "Remove the buttons and the pocket flaps from her blazer. Keep everything else exactly the same." Seeds 311 to 314. c-311 went on.

Pictures, step 2, the angle, your words: "Turn the character in image 1 looking to the left, same orientation as the body. Keep all features thick and sturdy, no fine strands or thin spikes. No text, no props, no extra subjects, no photorealism. Flat matte texture." Seeds 401 to 404 from c-311; your angled Mio on the right for comparison. They went flat 2D again, and the head turned more than the body.

Step 2 again with the 3D sentence added: "Keep her a 3D render with flat faceted low-poly surfaces, like image 1." Seeds 411 to 414. d-412 (body and head turned the same way) went to Meshy, as it is, white background.
3D model, step 3: Meshy image-to-3D from d-412, smart topology (meshy-t2), target 1,050 polygons, A-pose, no texture. 5 credits. Meshy's own previews: front, left, right.

The untextured shape in Blender (same camera and light as earlier rounds): front, her left three-quarter (image right side turned to us), her left side, back, face. 1,078 triangles; the in-game Eric has 1,120 and Mio 1,127.

Texture in a second pass (Meshy retexture styled from d-412, the shape's own UVs, lighting removed, no PBR). 10 credits. Front, her left three-quarter, her left side, back, her right three-quarter, face.

Kuro beside the in-game Meshy Eric and Mio, same camera, front and her right three-quarter. Mio renders smaller here because her file's bounding box is bigger; in the live viewer all three stand at the same height.

Step 4: Meshy auto-rig at height 1.1 m (Eric's setting, lowered for the big head). 5 credits. Stills from the live viewer: rest, idle, walk, walk from the side. The idle and walk are the game's (Mio's approved idle and walk, carried over by bone name), played on Kuro and the in-game Eric and Mio at once. She is not in the game.

options.label: kuro-1
options.note: The rigged model from d-412: smart topology, 1,078 triangles, textured in a second pass, auto-rigged at 1.1 m. 20 credits in all. Her head is smaller against her body than Eric's and Mio's, and her eyes are teal-green where the portrait's are grey. No glasses, no hair sticks.

Eric and Mio in the game's character viewer (Kuro isn't there; she's not in the game)

decision: Bad; redo with his exact process via ChatGPT's image model (kuro-meshy-orig-2)
